history.dynasty: Ancient Meitei; the surviving cults and shrines of Langmai Ningthou (Nongpok Ningthou) are centred on Nongmaiching (Selloi Langmai) Hill and nearby areas, under the institution of the Umang Laism
history.period: Ancient (cult of Langmai Ningthou); no founding date is documented for the Khangabok shrine
history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. Nongpok Ningthou (Old Manipuri: Langmai Ningthou), the ruling guardian deity of the eastern direction and one of the principal Umang Lais, belongs to Meitei mythology and the Sanamahi religion - the shrine is a Sanamahi/Umang Lai site, not a Hindu temple. Best-supported referent for the CSV row (town Thoubal): the Nongpok Ningthou shrine at Khangabok Mayai Leikai, Khangabok, Thoubal district (map listing: 'Nongpok Ningthou, Khangabok, Thoubal 795148'; geocoded 24.61449, 94.00475). CSV correction: the district (Thoubal) is correct, but the town is more precisely Khangabok, not Thoubal town. Related Nongpok sites in the same district: the Nongpok Ningthou Panthoibi Hill pantheon at Yairipok (per Wikipedia) and the Langmeithet Nongpok Ningthou Panthoibi gate (Thoubal district, inaugurated January 2016 per KanglaOnline/manipur.org). Other laishangs exist at Takhellambam Laikai and Yanglem Leikai (Bishnupur), the Leingangpokpi erat thouni in the middle of the Jiri river (Jiribam), and Kwatha. Note on syncretism: shrines of Langmai Ningthou independent of the Umang Laism were absorbed into Hinduism in the post-Charairongba era - e.g. the Chingyai shrine became the Shiva Mahadeva cult under King Chandrakirti (1850-1886) - and Yairipok's hilltop Kwarok Sarang Laisaba shrine is called Kwarok Mahadev by local Hindus; whether the Khangabok shrine carries a similar Hindu overlay is not documented. Identity certainty: medium - Khangabok is the only geocoded 'Nongpok Ningthou' listing in Thoubal district, but no descriptive web source for that specific shrine was found; Yairipok is the district's most-cited Nongpok sacred site.

name: Nongpok Ningthou Temple
town: Khangabok (CSV town 'Thoubal' is the district; the shrine is at Khangabok)
town_description: Khangabok is a town in Thoubal district, Manipur, a few kilometres south-east of Thoubal town in the Manipur valley's southern paddy belt. Thoubal district is the southern neighbour of Imphal, known for its agricultural plains; Khangabok Part 2 (Mayai Leikai) is the geocoded locality of the Nongpok Ningthou shrine.
tradition: Sanamahism (Meitei indigenous religion); Nongpok Ningthou is one of the principal Umang Lais
